_about: Correlation between measured traits (R/correlation.R, data_type traits). Biodes: analysis.correlation = {variables: [columns], method: pearson | spearman | kendall, adjust: p.adjust method, within_design: true | false}.
_note_within_design: also correlate the residuals of each trait on the design's fixed part (treatments, blocks): across plots, traits that both respond to a treatment correlate even with no relation within a treatment.
_note_strength: rough guide (Cohen 1988); field-dependent; judge by the coefficient and its CI, not the p-value.
reference: Pearson 1895; Spearman 1904 Am J Psychol 15:72; Kendall 1938 Biometrika 30:81; Holm 1979; R Core stats::cor.test
_note_method_by_type: when Biodes did not state the method (no analysis.correlation.method, or assumptions["analysis.correlation.method"] set), each pair uses Pearson only if both traits are continuous (or 0/1: point-biserial) and Spearman if either is a count or ordinal (primary_outcome.type, secondary_outcomes[].type; Biodes 0e5dcc9). A stated method applies to every pair.
